messages:
Liam: FYI canary of model v2.2 (kernel-selector tweak) is showing a ~28% increase in p95 token latency for /chat/long-context routes. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/route/chat.long?cmp=v2.2
Maya: Saw that. Looks correlated with the selector preferring fused-attn when seq_len > 1024.
Aisha: Can you paste the token-level waterfall? that's the best diff for KV/cache interactions.
Liam: Quick slice from the profiler attached to dashboard: extra memcpy at generation token ~40, and a cluster of KCACHE misses during prefix loads. Suspect KV cache miss path is rebuilding large KV buckets.
Jorge: Reminder: we lowered kv_eviction_bytes in the runtime experiment two deploys ago (64MB -> 48MB). That can increase cold misses for long contexts.
Maya: Also the batching heuristic timeout was lowered (8ms -> 2ms) to reduce latency for small requests. More small batches + the fused kernel overhead could amplify p95 for long sequences.
Liam: Repro steps I used: run 10k canary requests with seq=1200, model v2.1 vs v2.2, track batch_size distribution (saved to /tmp/batches.json) and kv_hit_rate.
perf-bot: perf alert: p95_token_latency up 28% on route chat.long (canary v2.2). metrics: v2.1 p95=51ms -> v2.2 p95=65ms; kv_hit_rate down 0.7% -> 0.2% on this route.
Aisha: Proposed mitigations: 1) revert kernel-selector heuristic to prefer compiled-kernel for seq > 1024; 2) restore kv_eviction_bytes=64MB; 3) bump batch timeout to 6ms; 4) add token-level waterfall & KV hit ratio overlay on route-level dashboard.
Jorge: +1 rollback kernel selector first (lowest risk). If that fixes, we can iterate on batching/kv separately.
deploy-bot: rollback scheduled: canary v2.2 -> v2.1 at 1768510299 if no objections.
Maya: I'll open a dashboard ticket to add model-version comparison panels (waterfall, per-token latency histogram, kv_hit_rate overlay): https://redwood.internal/issue/789
Liam: Logs/profiling snippet I ran:
```
# collect traces
rbw profiler collect --model v2.2 --route chat.long --samples 200 --out /tmp/v2.2-trace
rbw logs tail --since 5m | grep kv_miss | head -n 50
```
Aisha: I'll work on a guard in the selector: only pick fused-attn if kv_hit_rate > 0.95 and avg_batch_size >= 8. Quick patch will be a canary gate.
Jorge: FWIW seen similar on some T4 variants when quant path + fused kernel triggers extra recompute due to memory layout. Worth checking kernel memory copies vs in-place path.
Maya: Action items: 1) deploy-bot rollback now (in flight), 2) Aisha to open PR with selection guard, 3) perf team to add token-waterfall panel + KV overlay on per-route dashboard, 4) ops to revert kv_eviction_bytes in canary if rollback doesn't clear it.
Liam: Thx. Ping me if rollback doesn't clear perf in 15m — I'll run another 10k replicate. :thumbsup:
